game.title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Blacklist
game.blurb: Stealth action game from Ubisoft Toronto, published by Ubisoft Entertainment, released 2013-08-20. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters follow the campaign missions named in the Steam achievements, plus the side missions, difficulty and play-style goals.

chapters.title: Safehouse to Abandoned Mill
chapters.summary: The first five missions named in the achievements: Safehouse, Insurgent Stronghold, American Consumption, Private Estate and Abandoned Mill.

chapters.title: Special Missions HQ to LNG Terminal
chapters.summary: Special Missions HQ, Transit Yards (and its hostages), Detention Facility, the attack on Paladin and LNG Terminal, then finishing the campaign. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Realistic, Perfectionist and No-Kill Runs
chapters.summary: Every mission on Realistic and on Perfectionist, and the whole campaign without killing anyone as Sam Fisher.

chapters.title: 4th Echelon Missions
chapters.summary: The full sets of 4th Echelon Missions from Andriy Kobin, Anna Grímsdóttir and Charlie Cole.

chapters.title: Headquarters and Play Styles
chapters.summary: Fully upgrading your headquarters and mastering the Ghost, Panther and Assault play styles on seven missions each.

chapters.title: Stealth, Takedowns and Gadgets
chapters.summary: Undetected missions, distractions, hiding bodies, Mark & Execute, the Tri-Rotor and taking a shield from a Shielded Infantryman.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3933); RAWG lists no additions for it. Steam app 235600 ("Tom Clancy’s Splinter Cell Blacklist" in the store list and in its schema) was used. StrategyWiki has no page under "Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Blacklist" or "Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Blacklist". splintercell.fandom.com answers the API under "Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Blacklist" with about 244 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 28 Steam achievements is hidden (API numbers skip 14 to 17 and 30). The ten mission names come from the achievement descriptions; their order follows the API numbers, which also fall steadily in unlock rate (10.1% to 4.6%), and the split after Abandoned Mill is our own choice. "Survive the attack on Paladin" is counted with the missions because it sits among them in the list. The three 4th Echelon Missions sets are named by who gives them; the data does not say whether they are solo or co-op.
